projectionState: Concrete open/client-registered instance; closed popup is unmounted or explicitly kept hidden by source Presence options.
sourceRule: Select is a direct alias of SelectPrimitive.Root, not a native select wrapper. Generic value/defaultValue and onValueChange distinguish single Value|null from multiple arrays. open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange/onOpenChangeComplete are independent of selected value; default modal=true. Root name/form/required/autoComplete use its hidden form control; object labels/form values use itemToStringLabel/itemToStringValue and comparison uses isItemEqualToValue. SelectValue resolves labels from Root items or registered ItemText; it is not a label for the field. Trigger defaults native button role=combobox with size sm|default. Content defaults bottom/center, offsets4/0 and alignItemWithTrigger=true; it inserts scroll arrows and List automatically. Items are role=option; disabled entries can be focused but cannot commit, while closed typeahead skips disabled choices. Single commit requests closing separately, even if the value callback is canceled; multiple toggles array values and normally stays open. readOnly locks changes but deliberately allows opening/browsing. GroupLabel/Separator are actual primitive parts; no text-query input, filter, server fetch or custom command event is invented.
keyboardAndFocus: Trigger Enter/Space/opening arrows operate the source popup. Open Up/Down/Home/End and label typeahead move highlight; Enter/Space choose an enabled option. Closed-trigger typeahead can commit a single value, but is disabled for readOnly or multiple. Escape dismisses without selecting a highlighted candidate; controlled open/value callbacks remain separately authoritative. Disabled Root suppresses interaction. Named visible label and error/help relations belong to the caller, not the placeholder.

protocol: SCXML observes actual source callback/native transactions, retaining original eventDetails. For cmdk, SOURCE_QUERY_CHANGE observes CommandInput.onValueChange and SOURCE_HIGHLIGHT observes Command.onValueChange: same public callback name, different actual part/authority. Sends never dispatch extra DOM events. CommandDialog is the composed Dialog actor and retains its full existing lifecycle/focus/deferred-unmount contract; this machine records its open authority without reimplementing that actor. Highlight or typing is never a command invocation. Source query/filter normalization, positioning and focus remain with the real primitive.

root.description: Direct primitive Root alias owns selected/open and form control; no wrapper DOM.

field.description: Chosen wrapper for native label/help and actual hidden source form input.

form-input.description: Actual Root validation/form input; visually hidden, tabindex=-1, value follows selected serialization.

trigger.description: Real native Button role combobox; public data-size sm/default.

form-values.description: Actual multiple-mode repeated hidden values, distinct from unnamed validation proxy.

value.description: Actual value label output, separate from the field label.

trigger-icon.description: Actual private indicator render SVG itself, not a fabricated extra span wrapper.

popup.description: Actual Popup is presentation because this wrapper inserts List.

list.description: Actual private List owns listbox semantics and trigger aria-controls target.

label.description: Actual GroupLabel, not a field label.

item.description: Actual option; disabled remains focusable but cannot commit.

scroll-up.description: Actual decorative pointer-scroll arrow; name does not promise native Button role.

scroll-down.description: Actual decorative pointer-scroll arrow; rendered/placed by primitive overflow.
